name: Red nose, tail heroes
description: White with the whole nose section red back to about a quarter of the length, closed by a thin dark blue band; 'norwegian' in white on the red. The white fin carries a portrait of a Nordic 'tail hero' (each aircraft a different person) with a red name plate at the root, under a red tip cap and a dark blue stripe.

logos.description: A drawn portrait of a Nordic hero (Anders Celsius, Knud Rasmussen, Thor Heyerdahl, Freddie Mercury ...), head and shoulders in dark blue-gray line art with touches of red and blue, often with a symbol of their work beside them; different on each aircraft. Their name in white on the red plate below, with a one-line description.

titles.style: The Norwegian wordmark: bold rounded sans, all lowercase, with a small dark blue swoosh under 'an'; on the red, below the windows behind the cockpit.
The wordmark again, small, above the windows behind the wing.

notes: Drawn on 737 MAX 8s (left and right sides agree). The tail portrait and the name on the plate change with each aircraft (airframe-specific: not drawn here). Small type text under the rear windows and the registration are left out. The winglet colors are only glimpsed (red, perhaps with the blue stripe): low confidence. The belly under the red nose is red all round as far as the photos show; the rest of the belly is assumed white (not seen from below). Engines are plain light gray. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on LN-FGH (side-on from below, 2026-03-23): the nose title is smaller than drawn (its lowercase about 0.8 m tall, about 0.08 of the fuselage's height; it had been drawn nearly twice that), running x 0.079-0.181 with its baseline at y -0.21; the aft title x 0.731-0.785. Both all-lowercase: height is a cap height with xHeight 0.72, so the lowercase comes out at the measured size.
history: Replaced Skyarium v1's approximation (2026-11). The red-nose scheme with tail heroes dates from 2002 and has had only small changes (the old 'norwegian.no/.com' titles have gone).
